exposure: Existing corpus outcomes were available before review. All counterfactuals are post hoc simulator diagnostics, not new game observations or live-disabled skills.
contract: Preserve exact recorded full kits, troop tiers, stats, engagement type and round limits. No fitted stats or magnitude tuning. Only deterministic full-kit cases reviewed; stochastic fixtures explicitly listed as skipped even where historical filenames/descriptions say no chance. Score is surviving attacker minus defender including draws; preserve winner and both sides. Repeated fixture entries or stored copies are not automatically independent observations.

definition.description: Reducing all enemy Troops' Attack by X%

variants.omit: Remove only this skill effect in the simulator; preserve all recorded heroes and skill levels.
variants.hero_class_only: Restrict the same effect to enemy.infantry; other recipients receive no contribution from this skill.
variants.bucket_active.hero.damage.down: Keep value and scope; use active.hero.damage.down instead of active.hero.attack.down.
variants.bucket_active.hero.lethality.down: Keep value and scope; use active.hero.lethality.down instead of active.hero.attack.down.
